blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-22: the exact YToken implementation rejects blacklisted senders and recipients in _update, and its manager can call burnYToken(from, shares) without an allowance. These are direct holder restriction and seizure controls; true replaces the prior possible posture.

oracleRisk.summary: YieldFi calculates yUSD NAV as Series Assets minus Series Liabilities divided by tokens outstanding. Its terms require valuation at least twice weekly, use Chainlink or an equivalent source for on-chain assets, and permit an issuer-selected market-practice or execution-based fallback when pricing is unavailable; the cadence and discretionary fallback make this a laggy top-level NAV process.

branchApplicability.rationale: The token terms define one series-level NAV and redemption process. They expressly mark collateral requirements and liquidation policy not applicable, and holders do not open borrower positions, so there are no collateral-liquidation branches beyond this top-level valuation path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: YieldFi yUSD has ten local native YToken/YTokenL2 issuance routes and a separate YieldFi BridgeCCIP transfer rail using Chainlink CCIP. BridgeCCIP burns local L2 shares before sending and mints them only after Router-delivered CCIP validation; Ethereum locks and unlocks yUSD through the verified LockBox. Per-chain controls preserve the shared CCIP/DON failure domain alongside each exact BridgeCCIP or LockBox controller. This transfer accounting is supply-conserving when peer and message checks hold and remains separate from each deployment's local native issuance.

controls.label: YieldFi Administrator BRIDGE and LOCKBOX role registry

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The common Administrator role registry controls which BridgeCCIP and LockBox contracts hold the BRIDGE or LOCKBOX roles used by the transfer rail. Its bridge-role administration is separate from the native YIELD role path retained in Mint Authority.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The complete current allowed-peer matrix was not independently enumerated; this control preserves the common role-registry failure domain without treating role membership as peer validation.

controls.capDescription: Granting or revoking BRIDGE and LOCKBOX roles changes which contracts may invoke route-level burn/mint accounting or LockBox unlock. The Administrator can change this bridge authorization immediately through its ADMIN-controlled registry.

sources.label: YieldFi Administrator role replay and current reads

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770718, the common Administrator 0x10472f91f67c49260bdd65f016ea0757bb1fc91e remained the role registry for the reviewed BridgeCCIP and LockBox path. The prior complete role replay at block 25575158 recorded BRIDGE holders 0x7cccd8ef51227a6c76c3824ed5e176cdc9598f7b, 0xce6beb6b0d349161a71cf547be769900ebcde358, 0x6d4f2f0a647c29983afb77ce3d35c085e851a97f, 0x6be164af10879a86e4643089638b6864ef12b1ee, and 0xace45ffffafb20a5b0b68ff3c4cf312551d4cfff, plus LOCKBOX holder 0x659b5bc7f2f888db3d5901b78cdb34df270e2231. Current BRIDGE reads independently returned true for each of the ten BridgeCCIP addresses at the route-specific blocks below. Non-ADMIN role changes are immediate; the exact allowed-peer matrix remains an evidence gap.

controls.label: YieldFi Ethereum BridgeCCIP transfer controller

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: BridgeCCIP send() locks yUSD in the Ethereum LockBox and receive processing unlocks or synchronizes the corresponding locked balance through the bridge-only path.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: send() and _ccipReceive() enforce the configured allowed peer and processed-message checks; the complete current allowed-peer matrix was not independently enumerated.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The Ethereum route is lock/unlock accounting through the LockBox; it is supply-conserving when the configured peer and validated CCIP message checks hold.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770717, 0x6be164af10879a86e4643089638b6864ef12b1ee held the Administrator's BRIDGE role. The verified BridgeCCIP source checks the configured LockBox and peer on send(), validates processed messages and the allowed peer on _ccipReceive(), and delegates the Ethereum lock/unlock accounting to the LockBox. This is bridge machinery, not an independent native mint authority.

controls.label: YieldFi Ethereum LockBox bridge escrow

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The verified Ethereum LockBox is a proxy whose unlock() surface is bridge-only; its _sync path delegates the corresponding lock/unlock accounting update to the YieldFi Manager.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: LockBox unlock and synchronization represent the Ethereum side of BridgeCCIP accounting and are bounded by the prior lock/validated route message when peer and message checks hold.

controls.evidence: The Ethereum LockBox 0x659b5bc7f2f888db3d5901b78cdb34df270e2231 is the verified bridge escrow for the L1 route. Its bridge-only unlock() and Manager-delegating _sync path preserve the adverse escrow and accounting failure domain without treating the LockBox as a global native minter.

controls.label: Chainlink CCIP DON/RMN validator authority

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: Chainlink's architecture documentation describes commit-DON consensus and independent Risk Management Network blessing, but the exact production DON/RMN validator membership, authority, and controlling contract set for these selected routes were not independently verified.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The exact per-chain Chainlink Router and YieldFi BridgeCCIP delivery contracts remain identified in the route-specific controls. This protocol-level control models only the external DON/RMN authority and therefore does not inherit those contract identities.

controls.evidence: The verified route-specific BridgeCCIP implementations identify the exact delivery controller and configured Chainlink Router, then enforce allowed-peer and replay checks. Chainlink's documentation establishes a separate DON/RMN validation layer, but the reviewed evidence does not establish an exact validator authority or one controllerAddress for that layer, so its authority remains unresolved.
